newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's,Wendy's down on price war worry - analyst.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's,Wendy's down on price war worry - analyst.

text.p: Shares of fast-food companies McDonald's Corp and Wendy's International Inc were off Wednesday on concerns that heavy price discounting by McDonald's could spark a price war, an analyst said.
McDonald's shares were down 2-1/2 at 44-3/4, while Wendy's shares were off 2-1/8 at 20-1/8.
"I can smell a price war," Piper Jaffray analyst Allan Hickok said.
The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday that McDonald's is proposing a big discounting program, which will cut the prices of some of its sandwiches to $0.55.
McDonald's was not available for comment on the report.
In an interview on Tuesday, McDonald's Chief Financial Officer Mike Conley declined to comment specifically about pricing.
But he reiterated that McDonald's, the largest fast-food operator, will be more aggressive on offering value to customers. "It (value) can incorporate pricing," Conley said Tuesday.
